content:
当前目录有一个 `logs/` 文件夹，里面有多个 `.log` 文件。

请完成以下任务：
1. 找出所有包含 "ERROR" 的日志行
2. 统计每个文件中 ERROR 的数量
3. 将结果保存到 `error_summary.json`，格式为 `{"filename": count, ...}`，按 count 降序排列

我来完成这个任务。首先查看当前目录结构，然后分析日志文件。

<tool_call>
{"name": "bash", "arguments": {"command": "ls -la"}}
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>bash</name>
<output>
total 0
drwxr-xr-x@ 3 liuchen  staff   96 May 25 16:58 .
drwxr-xr-x@ 3 liuchen  staff   96 May 25 16:58 ..
drwxr-xr-x@ 5 liuchen  staff  160 May 20 00:52 logs
</output>
</tool_result>

现在查看 logs 目录的内容：

<tool_call>
<arguments>
<name>bash</name>
{"command": "ls -la logs/"}
</arguments>
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>bash</name>
<output>
工具执行出错：handle() missing 1 required positional argument: 'command'
</output>
</tool_result>

<tool_call>
{"name": "bash", "arguments": {"command": "ls -la logs/"}}
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>bash</name>
<output>
total 24
drwxr-xr-x@ 5 liuchen  staff  160 May 20 00:52 .
drwxr-xr-x@ 3 liuchen  staff   96 May 25 16:58 ..
-rw-r--r--@ 1 liuchen  staff  372 May 20 00:52 app.log
-rw-r--r--@ 1 liuchen  staff  274 May 20 00:52 auth.log
-rw-r--r--@ 1 liuchen  staff  443 May 20 00:52 worker.log
</output>
</tool_result>

现在查看每个日志文件的内容，找出包含 "ERROR" 的行并统计数量：

<tool_call>
<arguments>
<name>bash</name>
{"command": "grep -c \"ERROR\" logs/*.log"}
</arguments>
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>bash</name>
<output>
工具执行出错：handle() missing 1 required positional argument: 'command'
</output>
</tool_result>

<tool_call>
{"name": "bash", "arguments": {"command": "grep -c \"ERROR\" logs/*.log"}}
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>bash</name>
<output>
logs/app.log:3
logs/auth.log:1
logs/worker.log:5
</output>
</tool_result>

现在让我查看一下实际的 ERROR 行以确认：

<tool_call>
<arguments>
<name>bash</name>
{"command": "grep \"ERROR\" logs/*.log"}
</arguments>
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>bash</name>
<output>
工具执行出错：handle() missing 1 required positional argument: 'command'
</output>
</tool_result>

<tool_call>
{"name": "bash", "arguments": {"command": "grep \"ERROR\" logs/*.log"}}
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>bash</name>
<output>
logs/app.log:2024-03-15 10:00:15 ERROR Database connection timeout
logs/app.log:2024-03-15 10:01:30 ERROR Failed to parse JSON payload
logs/app.log:2024-03-15 10:02:45 ERROR Redis connection refused
logs/auth.log:2024-03-15 10:01:15 ERROR Invalid token: expired
logs/worker.log:2024-03-15 10:01:00 ERROR Task queue overflow: 1024 pending
logs/worker.log:2024-03-15 10:02:00 ERROR Failed to process job #4521
logs/worker.log:2024-03-15 10:02:30 ERROR Failed to process job #4522
logs/worker.log:2024-03-15 10:03:00 ERROR Deadlock detected in worker 2
logs/worker.log:2024-03-15 10:03:30 ERROR Failed to process job #4523
</output>
</tool_result>

现在我有统计结果：
- logs/app.log: 3个ERROR
- logs/auth.log: 1个ERROR  
- logs/worker.log: 5个ERROR

按count降序排列，创建error_summary.json文件：

<tool_call>
<arguments>
<name>file_write</name>
{"path": "error_summary.json", "content": "{\n  \"logs/worker.log\": 5,\n  \"logs/app.log\": 3,\n  \"logs/auth.log\": 1\n}"}
</arguments>
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>file_write</name>
<output>
工具执行出错：handle() missing 2 required positional arguments: 'path' and 'content'
</output>
</tool_result>

<tool_call>
{"name": "file_write", "arguments": {"path": "error_summary.json", "content": "{\n  \"logs/worker.log\": 5,\n  \"logs/app.log\": 3,\n  \"logs/auth.log\": 1\n}"}}
</tool_call>

<tool_result>
<name>file_write</name>
<output>
已写入 /Users/liuchen/Desktop/deepseek-cli/liuchen-best-cli/benchmark/results/run_20260525_162639/oib5_t04_file_search/workspace/error_summary.json (5 行, 69 字节)
</output>
</tool_result>

任务完成。我已经：

1. 找到了所有包含 "ERROR" 的日志行（共9行）
2. 统计了每个文件中 ERROR 的数量：
   - logs/worker.log: 5个ERROR
   - logs/app.log: 3个ERROR
   - logs/auth.log: 1个ERROR
3. 将结果保存到 `error_summary.json` 文件中，格式按要求为 `{"filename": count, ...}`，并按 count 降序排列

你可以查看生成的 `error_summary.json` 文件来确认结果。
